title: Torsade Huggies
category: Earrings (chunky twisted-rope hinged huggie hoops, sold as 1 pair)
metal: 18k gold tone (listing: PVD 18K gold coating; base metal not stated), high-polish mirror finish, warm rich yellow. Every photo shows this one tone; there is no rhodium silver tone option.
lock: 1 pair of hinged huggies, each a 20 x 18 mm round hoop of 1 chunky 4-5 mm tube twisted like rope: about 4 rounded ridges across the band, spiralling one way all round; 1 thin plain wire post spans the top quarter into the other end; smooth inner face; 0 stones. Mirror-polished 18k gold tone. Must stay a fat twisted rope tube, never a thin, braided or chain hoop.
morph: The twisted rope tube. Image models (1) thin it into a fine twisted-wire or cable hoop, (2) smooth the ridges into a plain domed hoop, or (3) split it into a braid, a stack of separate rings or a rope chain. Second risk is the hinge: the thin wire post at the top gets dropped (a closed ring) or swapped for a lever-back or hook. Third is scale: earlier colour ads (performance/build/colour50.json, colour_dropped.json, shot 27) ran 1.3-1.4x true size beside props, and a hoop lying flat (photo 01) reads as a ring, so never show it on a finger.
sizeMm: Approximately 20 mm tall x 18 mm wide, give or take 1 mm (listing description and size-guide photo 05 with its 10 mm ruler). My estimates from photo 05 at about 23 px/mm, not listed: tube about 4-5 mm thick, inner opening about 10 mm, wire post spanning a gap of about 7 mm at the top. Referents: about the 20 mm diameter of an Indian 2019-series 1-rupee coin; worn (photo 03), it runs from the piercing to just below the lobe, about a third of the ear's height, with more than half the hoop hanging below the lobe edge.

story: The everyday hoop given a bit of craft: a chunky hoop turned like a rope, so instead of one flat flash the light breaks into short bright lines all the way round (the listing's own line). It looks bold and costly, yet it sits close to the lobe and stays light enough for every day, and the price is now Rs 999 (down from Rs 1,799 at Edition One launch). 'Torsade' is French for twist and is also the word for a cable stitch in knitting. Visual rhymes: twisted ivory taper candles in brass holders (scored 9.2 in the colour ads), khari puff-pastry straws and chai, kai murukku, fusilli, a barley-sugar twist, a Solomonic twisted column, a cable-knit sweater, the ridges of a whelk shell, a coiled jute or silk rope, a rope-twist gold kada. Styling, per the listing: a plain stud above for a simple stacked ear. It suits slicked-back hair, white shirts, cable knits and festive silks alike.
copyNotes: Use: twisted rope, torsade, twist, rope texture all the way round, catches light in short bright lines, chunky, close to the lobe, 20 mm, 18k gold tone, PVD 18k gold coating (a listed fact, stated as material only, not as a durability promise), hinged, 1 pair, pre-order, Rs 999, a plain stud above for a stacked ear. Avoid: 'huggie'/'huggies' in body copy (an Indian nappy brand; the product title is the only exception); 'gold', '18k gold' or 'solid gold' without 'tone'; 'waterproof', 'tarnish free', 'anti-tarnish', 'sweatproof', 'keeps its colour', 'long-lasting' or 'hypoallergenic' (no claim tags; the description's anti-tarnish and sweat lines are not tagged, so do not claim them); 'stainless steel', 'sterling', 'brass' or any base metal; any stone word (CZ, crystal, diamond); 'silver'; 'braid', 'braided', 'chain' or 'cable chain'; 'small' or 'tiny' (the old alt text says small, but it is a chunky 20 mm hoop); 'croissant hoops' as a product name (a croissant is fine as a visual rhyme); any designer name, 'dupe' or 'inspired by'; 'KAVNAR' (a supplier tag); 'in stock' or 'ships now' (it is pre-order); the old prices Rs 1,799, Rs 1,299 and Rs 1,199; any size other than 20 x 18 mm.

photos.shows: Macro (E156970_5): 1 hoop lying flat on ivory plaster, angled from above. Shows the fat tube with rounded diagonal rope ridges all the way round, the smooth polished inside, and the thin wire post at the back left. 18k gold tone, mirror polish. Best ridge detail, but lying flat it reads as a ring and fills the frame, so do not use it for scale.

Packshot (hero): the pair on a white plaster cube against a warm cream-beige backdrop. The left hoop stands side-on, showing the twisted outer face, the smooth inner wall and the hinge at the top. The right hoop lies tilted, showing the twisted band and the hinge end. 18k gold tone. Reference 1.

Worn: profile of a woman with dark hair and a cream knit top. 1 hoop sits in the lobe, seen three-quarter: the twisted outer face, the smooth inner channel, and more than half the hoop below the lobe. 18k gold tone. True scale, about a third of the ear's height. Reference 2.
Packaging: the blush NAIRA gift box with a pink satin ribbon on white. No product visible.

Size guide: the pair standing on a plaster block, the left hoop face-on (full circle, the wire post across the top quarter, ridges all round) and the right side-on, with 20 mm and 18 mm bars, a 10 mm ruler and 'Measurements are approximate, give or take 1 mm'. The clearest construction view, but its text overlay rules it out as a generation reference. Use it to check verifications.
